notices.info: Prizes may be distributed in-person or shipped post-hackathon. Each member of each winning team will get the prize. Prizes will be distributed during closing ceremony.
notices.warning: A team may not win more than one prize total from the Grand Prizes and Track Prizes. They may win multiple prizes from Challenge Prizes, even in addition to a grand or track prize.

grandPrizes.title: 1st Place Overall
grandPrizes.description: This prize is awarded to the first-place project across all tracks.
grandPrizes.award: 1st Prize Overall is a pair of Apple Airpods 4 for all team members!

grandPrizes.title: 2nd Place Overall
grandPrizes.description: This prize is awarded to the second-place project across all tracks.
grandPrizes.award: 2nd Prize Overall is a Fuji Film Instax Mini 11 Instant Film Camera for all team members!

grandPrizes.title: 3rd Place Overall
grandPrizes.description: This prize is awarded to the third-place project across all tracks.
grandPrizes.award: 3rd Prize Overall is an Anker Magnetic portable battery for all team members!

trackPrizes.title: Agriculture
trackPrizes.award: The Agriculture track's prize is an Uber Eats gift card for all team members!

trackPrizes.title: Productivity / Wellness
trackPrizes.award: The Productivity / Wellness track's prize is a comfy for all team members!

trackPrizes.title: Finance
